page.overview:
Who is Colter Family?

Not what you're looking for? See Colton (disambiguation)The Colter Family in Fazbear Frights comprises the relatives of Edward Colter from Friendly Face.

Main Article: Edward ColterEdward Colter is the main protagonist of Friendly Face. He is a nerdy but confident man who is best friends with Jack Weston.

Main Article: Ms. ColterEdward's unnamed mom is the mother of Edward Colter. She is a seemingly stressed out mother who is the only one taking care of Edward Colter.

Edward's unnamed dad is the father of Edward Colter and a minor mentioned character in Friendly Face. Not much is known about him other then that he gave Edward and Jack some building blocks to play with back when they were little. He left the family when Edward was three to move across the country, getting a new wife and 3 other kids.
